Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell: joint intake & field orchestration for Acme Health

Hi Priya / Claire / team,

Following up from last week's signal: Acme Health is ready to move from eval -> pilot and wants to explore a GCP co-sell path. I put together an intake checklist and an initial playline that outlines who owns what across sales, partner PM, and field engineering. Attaching the checklist and playline for quick review.

High-level asks:
- Priya: can you confirm which GCP partner incentive (co-sell) path we should use for a HealthCare customer in the US region?
- Claire: can you share the top 3 use cases and expected QPS so we can scope the Dedicated vs Hosted recommendation?
- Vanessa / Karthik / Ben: can we run a quick pre-call to align roles for the kickoff next week?

Attachments: Acme_intake_checklist.xlsx (Excel), GCP_co-sell_playline_v1.pdf (PDF)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick internal huddle (30m) — confirm roles and Miro board ownership
2) Joint call with Priya + Claire (45m) — scope pilot target, timeline, and pricing cadence
3) Draft Mutual Action Plan and HubSpot deal update

Link to deal & draft MAP: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-789012

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
[Attachment: Acme_intake_checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: joint intake & field orchestration for Acme Health

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good. Quick notes from the partner side:

- Priya: for healthcare customers we usually route through the ISV co-sell (GSI endorsement) path; there may be a short approval if PHI scope is broader. If Acme confirms no PHI persisted in logs, the standard ISV path should be fine.
- From our side, I can own the Marketplace listing readiness checklist and the initial technical validation with field eng.
- Karthik: will you own the lead routing and Marketplace listing updates once we confirm the SKU mapping?

Two immediate asks:
1) @Priya — please confirm inbound co-sell contact and if we should open a Cloud Partner Console ticket.
2) @Claire — can you add an expected token/day estimate in the intake spreadsheet so we can model cost?

Scheduling: I can do a 30m alignment on Monday 6/14 at 10am PT or Tuesday 6/15 at 9am PT. If those don't work, propose alternatives.

-Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Thanks all — looping in confirmation from the GCP co-sell ops team:

- Recommended path: ISV co-sell (Standard Marketplace + Co-sell engagement).
- Next step from Google: open a CPaaS ticket referencing the ISV co-sell intake and provide the HubSpot deal id (HS-789012). I'll sponsor that intro and track the ticket.
- For healthcare customers: GCP will require a short security attestation. If you can confirm data residency & classification and whether logs contain PHI, we can expedite.

I'm available for the alignment slot on Tue 6/15 at 9am PT. Looking forward to the joint call.

Best,
